name: Dream
description: "When a bug dies, their spirit does not vanish. Our memories remain, lingering in places we have been, upon things that we loved."

abilities.name: Dream Nail
abilities.description: Gain Essence Pool (max 5). Manifest weightless Dream Nail (Quality = Insight). Strikes spirits for 3 damage. Can cast Touch Dream Spells when striking.

abilities.name: Essence Tap
abilities.description: When striking with Dream Nail, gain 1 Soul and 1 Essence. Target must rest before being Tapped again.

abilities.name: Transference
abilities.description: On Dream Nail hit, opposed Insight check establishes Soul-leeching link. Target loses 1 Soul/turn, Adept gains 1 Soul/turn. Spend 1 Essence to increase leech rate.

abilities.name: Flicker of Foresight
abilities.description: While has Essence, may guess attack successes. If correct, defense dice count as 6s.

abilities.name: Whisper me the Way
abilities.description: Spend 5 Essence for vision of future relevant to goals (may be cryptic).
